title: My recurring dreamscape
content: I have a few dreamscapes that come and go mostly liminal spaces like schools, etc, sometimes a campground. However, I have this one in particular that has been there for a long time now.. I'm in a home which, during the dream, I perceive to be my Grandmother's house. It looks nothing like her actual house, and I am generally there alone. The house is really old. I've never seen the outside only the inside. It is really hard to navigate, but it feels like every time I go back I can get a little deeper. The room I typically start in is an entryway. Very dark, gloomy lighting, dusty old Victorian style home. It's really dingy and dark but I'm not scared at all. Feeling very safe and wanting to explore. I always find many many staircases, sometimes inaccessible ones, sometimes I know there's floors above me that I can not get to. There is a room in particular that is my favorite. It's a bedroom. What looks to be a child's room from long ago. When I'm there I remember it, but it is not a place I have ever been in in my waking life. There's two twin beds in either side of the room. Old toys, some of which I feel are old toys I've played with in the past (in this dream world), they are not actually familiar to me. When I get in the room I can walk to the far wall between the two beds and duck down and there's a crack in the wall above the floor. I can push myself through that crack and end up in an even larger bedroom. I've done this sometimes going 4-5 rooms deep. I always find myself wanting to go deeper and deeper into this house. I feel a sense of nostalgia and a sense of sadness when I wake up and it no longer exists. There are times when going to bed, I actively try to get there again. I hope this makes sense because it's really jumbled, but as shadowy and bittersweet as this place is, I miss it and wait for the night I get to visit it again.
